role.label: Schedule of Net Benefit Costs [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of the components of net benefit costs for pension plans and/or other employee benefit plans including service cost, interest cost, expected return on plan assets, gain (loss), prior service cost or credit, transition asset or obligation, and gain (loss) recognized due to settlements or curtailments.

role.terseLabel: Schedule of Gain (Loss) on Derivative and Non-Derivative Instruments Designated as Net Investment Hedges
role.label: Schedule of Net Investment Hedges, Statements of Financial Performance and Financial Position, Location [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure for net investment hedges of (a) the location and amount of gains and losses reported in the statement of financial performance and (b) the location and fair value amounts of the instruments reported in the statement of financial position.

role.label: Accounting Standards Update and Change in Accounting Principle [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of changes in accounting principles, including adoption of new accounting pronouncements, that describes the new methods, amount and effects on financial statement line items.

role.terseLabel: Schedule of Nonvested Performance-Based Units Activity
role.label: Schedule of Nonvested Performance-Based Units Activity [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of the changes in outstanding nonvested performance-based units.

role.label: Schedule of Other Nonoperating Income (Expense) [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of the components of non-operating income or non-operating expense that may include amounts earned from dividends, interest on securities, gains (losses) on securities sold, equity earnings of unconsolidated affiliates, net gain (loss) on sales of business, interest expense and other miscellaneous income or expense items.

role.label: Property, Plant and Equipment [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosure of information about physical assets used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Includes, but is not limited to, balances by class of assets, depreciation and depletion expense and method used, including composite depreciation, and accumulated deprecation.

role.terseLabel: Schedule of Restructuring and Related Costs [Table]
role.label: Restructuring Cost [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosure of information about restructuring cost. Includes, but is not limited to, expected cost, cost incurred, statement of income caption that includes restructuring cost recognized, and amount of restructuring reserve.

role.terseLabel: Schedule of Restructuring and Related Costs
role.label: Restructuring and Related Costs [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of costs incurred for restructuring including, but not limited to, exit and disposal activities, remediation, implementation, integration, asset impairment, and charges against earnings from the write-down of assets.

role.terseLabel: Schedule of Restructuring Reserve by Type of Cost
role.label: Schedule of Restructuring Reserve by Type of Cost [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of an entity's restructuring reserve that occurred during the period associated with the exit from or disposal of business activities or restructurings for each major type of cost. This element may also include a description of any reversal and other adjustment made during the period to the amount of an accrued liability for restructuring activities. This element may be used to encapsulate the roll forward presentations of an entity's restructuring reserve by type of cost and in total, and explanation of changes that occurred in the period.

role.label: Schedule of Revenue from External Customers and Long-Lived Assets, by Geographical Areas [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of information concerning material long-lived assets (excluding financial instruments, customer relationships with financial institutions, mortgage and other servicing rights, deferred policy acquisition costs, and deferred taxes assets) located in identified geographic areas and/or the amount of revenue from external customers attributed to that country from which revenue is material. An entity may also provide subtotals of geographic information about groups of countries.

role.terseLabel: Schedule of Segment Reporting Information, by Segment [Table]
role.label: Schedule of Segment Reporting Information, by Segment [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosure of information about profit (loss) and total assets by reportable segment.

role.label: Schedule of Segment Reporting Information, by Segment [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of the profit or loss and total assets for each reportable segment. An entity discloses certain information on each reportable segment if the amounts (a) are included in the measure of segment profit or loss reviewed by the chief operating decision maker or (b) are otherwise regularly provided to the chief operating decision maker, even if not included in that measure of segment profit or loss.

role.terseLabel: Schedule of Share-based Compensation Arrangements by Share-based Payment Award [Table]
role.label: Schedule of Share-Based Compensation Arrangements by Share-Based Payment Award [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosure of information about share-based payment arrangement.

role.terseLabel: Schedule of Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Option, Activity
role.label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Option, Activity [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure for stock option plans. Includes, but is not limited to, outstanding awards at beginning and end of year, grants, exercises, forfeitures, and weighted-average grant date fair value.

role.terseLabel: Schedule of Share-Based Payment Award, Stock Options, Valuation Assumptions
role.label: Schedule of Share-Based Payment Award, Stock Options, Valuation Assumptions [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of the significant assumptions used during the year to estimate the fair value of stock options, including, but not limited to: (a) expected term of share options and similar instruments, (b) expected volatility of the entity's shares, (c) expected dividends, (d) risk-free rate(s), and (e) discount for post-vesting restrictions.

role.terseLabel: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Restricted Stock and Restricted Stock Unit, Activity
role.label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Restricted Stock and Restricted Stock Unit, Activity [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Disclosure of the number and weighted-average grant date fair value for restricted stock and restricted stock units that were outstanding at the beginning and end of the year, and the number of restricted stock and restricted stock units that were granted, vested, or forfeited during the year.

role.label: Schedule of Short-Term Debt [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of short-term debt arrangements (having initial terms of repayment within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer) including: (1) description of the short-term debt arrangement; (2) identification of the lender or type of lender; (3) repayment terms; (4) weighted average interest rate; (5) carrying amount of funds borrowed under the specified short-term debt arrangement as of the balance sheet date; (6) description of the refinancing of a short-term obligation when that obligation is excluded from current liabilities in the balance sheet; and (7) amount of a short-term obligation that has been excluded from current liabilities in the balance sheet because of a refinancing of the obligation.

role.terseLabel: Schedule of Consolidated Statement of Changes in Equity
role.label: Schedule of Stockholders Equity [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of changes in the separate accounts comprising stockholders' equity (in addition to retained earnings) and of the changes in the number of shares of equity securities during at least the most recent annual fiscal period and any subsequent interim period presented is required to make the financial statements sufficiently informative if both financial position and results of operations are presented.

role.label: Schedule of Unrecognized Tax Benefits Roll Forward [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of the change in unrecognized tax benefits.

role.terseLabel: Schedule of Expected Amortization Expense for Acquired Amortizable Intangible Assets
role.label: Schedule of Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Future Amortization Expense [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of the amount of amortization expense expected to be recorded in succeeding fiscal years for finite-lived intangible assets.

role.label: Title of 12(b) Security
role.documentation: Title of a 12(b) registered security.

role.label: Security Exchange Name
role.documentation: Name of the Exchange on which a security is registered.

role.label: Segments [Domain]
role.documentation: Components of an entity that engage in business activities from which they may earn revenue and incur expenses, including transactions with other components of the same entity.

role.label: Segment, Expenditure, Addition to Long-Lived Assets
role.documentation: Amount of expenditure for addition to long-lived assets included in determination of segment assets by chief operating decision maker (CODM) or otherwise regularly provided to CODM. Excludes expenditure for addition to financial instrument, long-term customer relationship of financial institution, mortgage and other servicing rights, deferred policy acquisition cost, and deferred tax assets.

role.label: Segment Reporting Disclosure [Text Block]
role.documentation: The entire disclosure for reporting segments including data and tables. Reportable segments include those that meet any of the following quantitative thresholds a) it's reported revenue, including sales to external customers and intersegment sales or transfers is 10 percent or more of the combined revenue, internal and external, of all operating segments b) the absolute amount of its reported profit or loss is 10 percent or more of the greater, in absolute amount of 1) the combined reported profit of all operating segments that did not report a loss or 2) the combined reported loss of all operating segments that did report a loss c) its assets are 10 percent or more of the combined assets of all operating segments.

role.label: Segment Reporting Information [Line Items]
role.documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

role.label: Segment Reporting, Policy [Policy Text Block]
role.documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for segment reporting.

role.label: Selling, General and Administrative Expense
role.documentation: The aggregate total costs related to selling a firm's product and services, as well as all other general and administrative expenses. Direct selling expenses (for example, credit, warranty, and advertising) are expenses that can be directly linked to the sale of specific products. Indirect selling expenses are expenses that cannot be directly linked to the sale of specific products, for example telephone expenses, Internet, and postal charges. General and administrative expenses include salaries of non-sales personnel, rent, utilities, communication, etc.

role.label: Selling, General and Administrative Expenses [Member]
role.documentation: Primary financial statement caption encompassing selling, general and administrative expense.

role.label: Settled Litigation [Member]
role.documentation: Agreement reached between parties in a litigation that occurs without judicial intervention, supervision or approval.

role.label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Noncash Expense
role.documentation: Amount of noncash expense for share-based payment arrangement.

role.terseLabel: Retirement eligibility for employees, minimum years of service required (in years)
role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Award Requisite Service Period
role.documentation: Estimated period over which an employee is required to provide service in exchange for the equity-based payment award, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents the reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Award Vesting Period
role.documentation: Period over which grantee's right to exercise award under share-based payment arrangement is no longer contingent on satisfaction of service or performance condition, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days. Includes, but is not limited to, combination of market, performance or service condition.

role.terseLabel: Number of shares to be delivered based on percent of each performance share granted upon satisfaction of performance conditions (as a percent)
role.label: Share Based Compensation Arrangement By Share Based Payment Award Delivered Based On Performance Percentage
role.documentation: Number of shares that are delivered at the end of the three-year performance period that may be anywhere from zero to two hundred percent of the performance shares granted.

role.terseLabel: Performance shares awarded at estimated number of shares at the end of the performance period (as a percent)
role.label: Share Based Compensation Arrangement By Share Based Payment Award Delivered Estimated Number Of Shares At End Of Vesting Period Percentage
role.documentation: Performance shares awarded at estimated number of shares at the end of the performance period.

role.terseLabel: Option price, discount from market value at date of grant (as a percent)
role.label: Share Based Compensation Arrangement By Share Based Payment Award Employee Stock Purchase Plan Market Discount
role.documentation: The discount from the market value used to calculate the price at which employee stock purchase plan participants are entitled to purchase stock under the plan.

role.terseLabel: Option price, percentage of market value at date of grant (as a percent)
role.label: Share Based Compensation Arrangement By Share Based Payment Award Employee Stock Purchase Plan Market Grant Price Percentage
role.documentation: The percentage of the market value at which employee stock purchase plan participants are entitled to purchase stock under the plan.

role.terseLabel: Number of participants with outstanding options, restricted stock, or restricted stock units
role.label: Share Based Compensation Arrangement By Share Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Options Restricted Stock And Restricted Stock Units Number Of Participants
role.documentation: The number of participants with outstanding options, restricted stock, or restricted stock units.

role.terseLabel: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Additional Disclosures [Abstract]
role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Additional Disclosures [Abstract]
Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Forfeited in Period
role.documentation: The number of equity-based payment instruments, excluding stock (or unit) options, that were forfeited during the reporting period.

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Forfeitures, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
role.documentation: Weighted average fair value as of the grant date of equity-based award plans other than stock (unit) option plans that were not exercised or put into effect as a result of the occurrence of a terminating event.

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Grants in Period
role.documentation: The number of grants made during the period on other than stock (or unit) option plans (for example, phantom stock or unit plan, stock or unit appreciation rights plan, performance target plan).

role.terseLabel: Weighted-average grant-date fair value of restricted stock units (per unit) that were granted and performance share that were granted (in shares)
role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Grants in Period, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
role.documentation: The weighted average fair value at grant date for nonvested equity-based awards issued during the period on other than stock (or unit) option plans (for example, phantom stock or unit plan, stock or unit appreciation rights plan, performance target plan).

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Nonvested, Number
role.documentation: The number of non-vested equity-based payment instruments, excluding stock (or unit) options, that validly exist and are outstanding as of the balance sheet date.

role.terseLabel: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Nonvested, Number of Shares [Roll Forward]
role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Nonvested, Number of Shares [Roll Forward]
role.documentation: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Nonvested, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
role.documentation: Per share or unit weighted-average fair value of nonvested award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes share and unit options.

role.terseLabel: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Nonvested, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value [Abstract]
role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Nonvested, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value [Abstract]
Share Based Compensation Arrangement By Share Based Payment Award Equity Instruments Other Than Options Performance Change In Period
role.documentation: The increase or decrease in the number of equity-based payment instruments, excluding stock (or unit) options, attributable to performance change during the reporting period.

role.label: Share Based Compensation Arrangement By Share Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other Than Options Performance Change In Period Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
role.documentation: The weighted average fair value as of the grant date of equity-based award plans other than stock (unit) option plans, increased or decreased for performance change during the reporting period.

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Vested in Period
role.documentation: The number of equity-based payment instruments, excluding stock (or unit) options, that vested during the reporting period.

role.terseLabel: Intrinsic value of restricted stock units that vested and performance shares that were distributed
role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Vested in Period, Fair Value
role.documentation: Fair value of share-based awards for which the grantee gained the right by satisfying service and performance requirements, to receive or retain shares or units, other instruments, or cash.

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Vested in Period, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
role.documentation: The weighted average fair value as of grant date pertaining to an equity-based award plan other than a stock (or unit) option plan for which the grantee gained the right during the reporting period, by satisfying service and performance requirements, to receive or retain shares or units, other instruments, or cash in accordance with the terms of the arrangement.

role.terseLabel: Percent of stock-based compensation related to retiree-eligible population (as a percent)
role.label: Share Based Compensation Arrangement By Share Based Payment Award, Expense Portion Attributable To Retiree Eligible Population Percent
role.documentation: Percent of stock-based compensation related to retiree-eligible population.

role.label: Share Based Compensation Arrangement By Share Based Payment Award, Expense Recognition Eligible For Retirement Age
role.documentation: The age at which employees of the entity are eligible for retirement, which combined with reaching years of service triggers expense recognition of share based compensation expense, in years.

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Exercise Price
role.documentation: Agreed-upon price for the exchange of the underlying asset relating to the share-based payment award.

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Expected Dividend Rate
role.documentation: The estimated dividend rate (a percentage of the share price) to be paid (expected dividends) to holders of the underlying shares over the option's term.

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Expected Volatility Rate
role.documentation: The estimated measure of the percentage by which a share price is expected to fluctuate during a period. Volatility also may be defined as a probability-weighted measure of the dispersion of returns about the mean. The volatility of a share price is the standard deviation of the continuously compounded rates of return on the share over a specified period. That is the same as the standard deviation of the differences in the natural logarithms of the stock prices plus dividends, if any, over the period.

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Risk Free Interest Rate
role.documentation: The risk-free interest rate assumption that is used in valuing an option on its own shares.

role.terseLabel: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award Activity
role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award [Line Items]
role.documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Number of Additional Shares Authorized
role.documentation: Number of additional shares authorized for issuance under share-based payment arrangement.

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Number of Shares Authorized
role.documentation: Number of shares authorized for issuance under share-based payment arrangement.

role.terseLabel: Number of shares available for grant (in shares)
role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Number of Shares Available for Grant
role.documentation: The difference between the maximum number of shares (or other type of equity) authorized for issuance under the plan (including the effects of amendments and adjustments), and the sum of: 1) the number of shares (or other type of equity) already issued upon exercise of options or other equity-based awards under the plan; and 2) shares (or other type of equity) reserved for issuance on granting of outstanding awards, net of cancellations and forfeitures, if applicable.

role.terseLabel: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Additional Disclosures [Abstract]
role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Additional Disclosures [Abstract]
Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Exercisable, Number
role.documentation: The number of shares into which fully or partially vested stock options outstanding as of the balance sheet date can be currently converted under the option plan.

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Exercisable, Weighted Average Exercise Price
role.documentation: The weighted-average price as of the balance sheet date at which grantees can acquire the shares reserved for issuance on vested portions of options outstanding and currently exercisable under the stock option plan.

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Exercises in Period, Intrinsic Value
role.documentation: Amount of accumulated difference between fair value of underlying shares on dates of exercise and exercise price on options exercised (or share units converted) into shares.

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Expirations in Period
role.documentation: Number of options or other stock instruments for which the right to exercise has lapsed under the terms of the plan agreements.

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Forfeitures in Period
role.documentation: The number of shares under options that were cancelled during the reporting period as a result of occurrence of a terminating event specified in contractual agreements pertaining to the stock option plan.

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Grants in Period, Net of Forfeitures
role.documentation: Net number of share options (or share units) granted during the period.

role.terseLabel: Black-Scholes fair value (in dollars per share)
role.verboseLabel: Weighted average fair value per option granted (in dollars per share)
role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Grants in Period, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
role.documentation: The weighted average grant-date fair value of options granted during the reporting period as calculated by applying the disclosed option pricing methodology.

role.terseLabel: Aggregate intrinsic value for options outstanding
role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Intrinsic Value
role.documentation: Amount by which the current fair value of the underlying stock exceeds the exercise price of options outstanding.

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Number
role.documentation: Number of options outstanding, including both vested and non-vested options.

role.terseLabel: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding [Roll Forward]
role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding [Roll Forward]
role.documentation: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Weighted Average Exercise Price
role.documentation: Weighted average price at which grantees can acquire the shares reserved for issuance under the stock option plan.

role.terseLabel: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Weighted Average Exercise Price [Abstract]
role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Weighted Average Exercise Price [Abstract]

role.terseLabel: Share Based Compensation Arrangements By Share Based Payment Award, Award Type And Plan Name [Domain]
role.label: Award Type [Domain]
role.documentation: Award under share-based payment arrangement.

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangements by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Exercises in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price
role.documentation: Weighted average price at which option holders acquired shares when converting their stock options into shares.

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangements by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Expirations in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price
role.documentation: Weighted average price at which grantees could have acquired the underlying shares with respect to stock options of the plan that expired.

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangements by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Forfeitures in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price
role.documentation: Weighted average price at which grantees could have acquired the underlying shares with respect to stock options that were terminated.

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangements by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Grants in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price
role.documentation: Weighted average per share amount at which grantees can acquire shares of common stock by exercise of options.

role.label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement [Policy Text Block]
role.documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for award under share-based payment arrangement. Includes, but is not limited to, methodology and assumption used in measuring cost.

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Expiration Period
role.documentation: Period from grant date that an equity-based award expires, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents the reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Expected Term
role.documentation: Expected term of award under share-based payment arrangement, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

role.terseLabel: Aggregate intrinsic value for options exercisable
role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Exercisable, Intrinsic Value
role.documentation: Amount of difference between fair value of the underlying shares reserved for issuance and exercise price of vested portions of options outstanding and currently exercisable.

role.terseLabel: Weighted average remaining contractual life for options exercisable (in months)
role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Exercisable, Weighted Average Remaining Contractual Term
role.documentation: Weighted average remaining contractual term for vested portions of options outstanding and currently exercisable or convertible, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents the reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

role.terseLabel: Weighted average remaining contractual life for options outstanding (in months)
role.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Weighted Average Remaining Contractual Term
role.documentation: Weighted average remaining contractual term for option awards outstanding, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents the reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

role.documentation: Solventum Notes Loans And Facilities

role.documentation: Designated state or local jurisdiction entitled to levy and collect income tax.

role.documentation: Information by business segments.

role.documentation: Information by the different classes of stock of the entity.

role.documentation: Information by component of equity.

role.documentation: Event that occurred after the balance sheet date but before financial statements are issued or available to be issued.

role.documentation: Amount of decrease in obligation for supplier finance program from settlement.
